title: swi_process
description: Process the Susceptibility-weighted images. Ensure the inputs are post-phase unwrapping using PRELUDE.

magnitude_image.description: The magnitude image (Output from the PRELUDE program)
magnitude_image.title: Magnitude Image

phase_image.description: The phase image (Output from the PRELUDE program)
phase_image.title: Phase Image

swi_output.description: Name of the SWI processed output image
swi_output.title: SWI Output Image

stddev.description: Specify the standard deviation of the Gaussian Smoothing Filter. Default is 2.0
stddev.title: Standard Deviation

phase_mask_cutoff.description: Specify the negative phase mask cutoff frequency (in radians). Default is the minimum value of the phase image.
phase_mask_cutoff.title: Phase Mask Cutoff

phase_mask_right_cutoff.description: Specify the positive phase mask cutoff frequency (in radians). Default is the maximum value of the phase image.
phase_mask_right_cutoff.title: Phase Mask Right Cutoff

sigmoid_a.description: Specify 'a' for the sigmoid formula f(phase)=1/(1+exp(-a*(phase-b))). Default is 1.0. Meaningless with phase_method != sigmoid
sigmoid_a.title: Sigmoid A

sigmoid_b.description: Specify 'b' for the sigmoid formula f(phase)=1/(1+exp(-a*(phase-b))). Default is 0.0. Meaningless with phase_method != sigmoid
sigmoid_b.title: Sigmoid B

phase_multiplications.description: Specify the number of phase multiplications. Default is 4
phase_multiplications.title: Phase Multiplications

mip_level.description: Specify the number of levels of mIP across the y direction. Default is 4
mip_level.title: MIP Level

phase_mask_method.description: Specify the phase mask method. One of negative, positive, symmetric, asymmetric, sigmoid. Default is negative
phase_mask_method.title: Phase Mask Method
